description: Source code for em_cmd_exec_t class handling command execution, socket communication, SSL setup, and synchronization in a Wi-Fi mesh system.

classes.name: em_cmd_exec_t
classes.description: Class managing command execution, socket communication, SSL setup, and synchronization.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits on a condition variable with mutex lock.

methods.name: release_wait
methods.description: Signals the condition variable to wake waiting threads.

methods.name: load_params_file
methods.description: Loads parameters from a file into a buffer.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Creates and sends an event command to a specified service.

methods.name: get_port_from_dst_service
methods.description: Returns port number based on destination service type.

methods.name: get_path_from_dst_service
methods.description: Returns socket path based on destination service type.

methods.name: close_listener_socket
methods.description: Closes a listener socket and unlinks socket file if applicable.

methods.name: get_listener_socket
methods.description: Creates and binds a socket for listening based on service type.

methods.name: get_ep_for_dst_svc
methods.description: Establishes an SSL connection to a destination service.

methods.name: send_cmd

methods.name: init
